decision_basis: AI image semantics only; no reward/intervention score input
scope: all original 32 P4 geometry cases, retain exclusions
evidence_rule: preserve the original annotated evidence box and tokens; if original evidence region is not acceptable exclude rather than shrink or score-select
support_rule: Astra may mark conservative non-evidence tissue polygons from original annotated images; absent or uncertain support excludes; these are AI proposals, not verified lung masks

control_rule.forbidden: original evidence union expanded 10 percent in each dimension

source_rule.source: original local three-cell Chebyshev ring intersected with AI-approved support, excluding target and evidence margin

before_scoring: freeze support polygons, proposal rules, every exclusion and final manifest; use same original 32 patients and candidates for common-case old/new comparison
